summary: Kaniksu NF site in Pend Oreille County, WA: 40-ft pole tower with L-4 cab built 1935, abandoned 1936, no longer standing; FFLOS-registered 2020.

facts.design: 40-foot pole tower with an L-4 cab
facts.status_note: The lookout is no longer standing; a Washington lookout index lists it as removed.

access.note: No source read says whether the site is open to visitors.

events.note: 40-foot pole tower with an L-4 cab constructed
Tower and cab abandoned, about a year after construction
Registered with the Former Fire Lookout Sites on April 20, 2020

evidence.supports: location in Kaniksu National Forest, Pend Oreille County

evidence.quote: A 40 foot pole tower with a L-4 cab constructed in 1935 was abandoned just a year later in 1936. The lookout is no longer standing.

notes_for_editor: Build, abandonment and status agree across the FFLOS register, firelookout.com and WillhiteWeb. No source names staff, fires or a current condition. Brief record needed no corrections. Only one web search beyond the briefed pages; it found no new sources.
